bridge_events_reserved_fields_required.name: bridge_events_reserved_fields_required
bridge_events_reserved_fields_required.value: "bridge_events"."status" <> 'reserved' OR ("bridge_events"."reserved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "bridge_events"."reservation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

bridge_events_processing_state_timestamp.name: bridge_events_processing_state_timestamps
bridge_events_processing_state_timestamp.value: ("bridge_events"."processing_state" = 'unclaimed' AND "bridge_events"."model_claimed_at" IS NULL AND "bridge_events"."model_completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("bridge_events"."processing_state" = 'claimed' AND "bridge_events"."model_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bridge_events"."model_completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("bridge_events"."processing_state" = 'completed' AND "bridge_events"."model_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bridge_events"."model_completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

bridge_events_delivery_reconciled_at_all.name: bridge_events_delivery_reconciled_at_allowed
bridge_events_delivery_reconciled_at_all.value: "bridge_events"."delivery_reconciled_at" IS NULL OR ("bridge_events"."status" = 'delivery_unknown' AND "bridge_events"."processing_state" IN ('claimed', 'completed') AND "bridge_events"."model_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL)

bridge_events_cancelled_at_allowed.name: bridge_events_cancelled_at_allowed
bridge_events_cancelled_at_allowed.value: "bridge_events"."cancelled_at" IS NULL OR ("bridge_events"."kind" = 'wake' AND "bridge_events"."source" = 'leileios_sentinel' AND "bridge_events"."dispatch_started_at" IS NULL AND "bridge_events"."status" IN ('pending', 'reserved'))

conversation_exclusions_scope_node_consi.name: conversation_exclusions_scope_node_consistency
conversation_exclusions_scope_node_consi.value: ("conversation_exclusions"."scope" = 'conversation' AND "conversation_exclusions"."source_node_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_exclusions"."scope" = 'branch' AND "conversation_exclusions"."source_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("conversation_exclusions"."source_node_id")) > 0)

conversation_import_runs_completion_cons.name: conversation_import_runs_completion_consistency
conversation_import_runs_completion_cons.value: ("conversation_import_runs"."status" = 'processing' AND "conversation_import_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_import_runs"."status" IN ('executed', 'failed') AND "conversation_import_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_import_sources_storage_pair.name: conversation_import_sources_storage_pair
conversation_import_sources_storage_pair.value: ("conversation_import_sources"."storage_kind" IS NULL AND "conversation_import_sources"."storage_key" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_import_sources"."storage_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_import_sources"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_messages_path_consistency.name: conversation_messages_path_consistency
conversation_messages_path_consistency.value: ("conversation_messages"."is_current_path" = true AND "conversation_messages"."current_path_index" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_messages"."current_path_index" >= 0) OR ("conversation_messages"."is_current_path" = false AND "conversation_messages"."current_path_index" IS NULL)

conversation_messages_provenance_consist.name: conversation_messages_provenance_consistency
conversation_messages_provenance_consist.value: ("conversation_messages"."source_node_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_messages"."parent_source_node_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_messages"."source_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "conversation_messages"."first_seen_import_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_messages"."last_seen_import_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversation_messages"."source_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_messages"."source_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_messages"."first_seen_import_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_messages"."last_seen_import_id" IS NOT NULL)

conversations_lifecycle_exclusive.name: conversations_lifecycle_exclusive
conversations_lifecycle_exclusive.value: NOT ("conversations"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

conversations_origin_provenance_consiste.name: conversations_origin_provenance_consistency
conversations_origin_provenance_consiste.value: ("conversations"."origin" = 'legacy_import' AND "conversations"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."source_conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."source_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."first_seen_import_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."last_seen_import_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("conversations"."origin" = 'native_live' AND "conversations"."provider" IS NULL AND "conversations"."source_conversation_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."source_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "conversations"."first_seen_import_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."last_seen_import_id" IS NULL)

sentinel_wake_runs_finalized_fields_requ.name: sentinel_wake_runs_finalized_fields_required
sentinel_wake_runs_finalized_fields_requ.value: ("sentinel_wake_runs"."state" <> 'finalized') OR ("sentinel_wake_runs"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."next_wake_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."completion_payload_hash" IS NOT NULL)

sentinel_wake_runs_non_finalized_fields_.name: sentinel_wake_runs_non_finalized_fields_null
sentinel_wake_runs_non_finalized_fields_.value: ("sentinel_wake_runs"."state" = 'finalized') OR ("sentinel_wake_runs"."decision" IS NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."next_wake_at" IS NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."finalized_at" IS NULL AND "sentinel_wake_runs"."completion_payload_hash" IS NULL)

sentinels_due_enabled_idle_idx.name: sentinels_due_enabled_idle_idx
sentinels_due_enabled_idle_idx.where: "sentinels"."enabled" = true AND "sentinels"."active_wake_run_id" IS NULL AND "sentinels"."next_wake_at" IS NOT NULL

tasks_completed_at_consistency.name: tasks_completed_at_consistency
tasks_completed_at_consistency.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" <> 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

tasks_resume_status_consistency.name: tasks_resume_status_consistency
tasks_resume_status_consistency.value: (("tasks"."status" IN ('pending', 'in_progress') AND "tasks"."resume_status" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND "tasks"."resume_status" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."resume_status" IN ('pending', 'in_progress')))

toy_commands_action_percent_consistency.name: toy_commands_action_percent_consistency
toy_commands_action_percent_consistency.value: ("toy_commands"."action" = 'set' AND "toy_commands"."percent" IS NOT NULL AND "toy_commands"."percent" BETWEEN 1 AND 50) OR ("toy_commands"."action" = 'stop' AND "toy_commands"."percent" IS NULL)

toy_commands_duration_seconds_consistenc.name: toy_commands_duration_seconds_consistency
toy_commands_duration_seconds_consistenc.value: ("toy_commands"."action" = 'set' AND "toy_commands"."duration_seconds" BETWEEN 1 AND 1200) OR ("toy_commands"."action" = 'stop' AND ("toy_commands"."duration_seconds" IS NULL OR "toy_commands"."duration_seconds" = 60))
